title: Primary School Children with Limited or No Access to Digital Devices and Network Connection for Learning
what_it_is: Primary School Children with Limited or No Access to Digital Devices and Network Connection for Learning

sections.label: School device loans for students
sections.summary: Schools can loan computers and Internet-enabling devices to primary students who lack devices for home school work, and students may use in-school computing facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In cases where primary students need to use devices after school hours but lack digital devices, schools can loan computers and Internet-enabling devices to students who need to use devices at home for school work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Our students also have the option to use the computing facilities in school.
